tools.name: create_custom_calendar
tools.description: Build a subscribable calendar of upcoming Bay Area events from the user's interests. Returns a link that opens the calendar on SFomo (open_on_sfomo; give the user this first), subscribe links (Google Calendar, Apple/Outlook webcal, plain .ics) and a preview. The calendar refreshes itself every few h

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming Bay Area events (dance, AI, music, arts, food, sports, comedy, fun, exercise, volunteer, dating, SF Tech Week). All words in `query` must match title/location/organizer/tags. Dates are Pacific, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: list_upcoming
tools.description: List the next N days of events, optionally for one category.
